newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber futures mixed in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber futures mixed in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were mixed in directionless after-hours trade on Thursday, as profit-taking was countered by bargain-hunting, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.3 yen per kilo lower to 0.4 yen up from the day's close. The benchmark May contract was 0.3 yen firmer at 142.0 yen. Volume was 9,415 lots.
During the day, the market drifted easier. "Investors may be reluctant to build fresh shorts below 140 yen for the benchmark, but the market lacked incentives to move higher," one trader said.
